name: heart
description: The heart: Garmin's daily resting, minimum and maximum heart rate, the watch's own hourly readings, and every alert it raised, without the rest of the health record. v5 adds health.heart-rate.hour, a UTC hour's 60 minute slots. v4 names the same types as v3 and only rewords this description. v3 named health.heart-rate.day, one fact a day; v2 named health.heart-rate-day, three a day; v1 named health.heart-rate-daily.
